name: Azure SQL - DatabaseWait Stats
description: See information about database wait events, including wait events by database and by database and wait type, wait type trends,  average wait time per task, and details for wait events.
title: Azure SQL - DatabaseWait Stats

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  "\"operationName\":\"DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName", "wait_type", "delta_max_wait_time_ms", "delta_signal_wait_time_ms", "delta_wait_time_ms", "delta_waiting_tasks_count"  nodrop
| where operationName = "DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent"
| concat(LogicalServerName, ":", DatabaseName) as Server_DatabaseName
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{wait_type}}" = "*", true, wait_type matches "{{wait_type}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|count as eventCount by Server_DatabaseName, wait_type
| transpose row Server_DatabaseName column wait_type

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  "\"operationName\":\"DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName", "wait_type", "delta_max_wait_time_ms", "delta_signal_wait_time_ms", "delta_wait_time_ms", "delta_waiting_tasks_count"  nodrop
| where operationName = "DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent"
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{wait_type}}" = "*", true, wait_type matches "{{wait_type}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|sum(delta_waiting_tasks_count) as sum_delta_waiting_tasks_count, sum(delta_wait_time_ms) as sum_delta_wait_time_ms by LogicalServerName, DatabaseName, ElasticPoolName, wait_type 
| sum_delta_wait_time_ms/sum_delta_waiting_tasks_count as Avg_Wait_Time_Per_Task
| sort by Avg_Wait_Time_Per_Task, sum_delta_waiting_tasks_count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  "\"operationName\":\"DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName", "wait_type", "delta_max_wait_time_ms", "delta_signal_wait_time_ms", "delta_wait_time_ms", "delta_waiting_tasks_count"  nodrop
| where operationName = "DatabaseWaitStatistcsEvent"
| timeslice 1s
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{wait_type}}" = "*", true, wait_type matches "{{wait_type}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|count as eventCount by _timeslice, LogicalServerName, DatabaseName, ElasticPoolName, wait_type, delta_max_wait_time_ms, delta_signal_wait_time_ms, delta_wait_time_ms, delta_waiting_tasks_count 
| sort by _timeslice
| fields -eventCount
